title: Engram project-reset abort releases the fence but never drains queued prompts, so a wake queued during an aborted settings change stays undelivered on an idle session
outcome: After an Engram project settings change aborts (abort_engram_project_reset) or its commit rolls back, every session the fence held has its queue drained, as release_engram_project_reset_fence does, so a wake queued during the fence starts its turn without another trigger.
acceptance: Engram project-reset abort releases the fence but never drains queued prompts, so a wake queued during an aborted settings change stays undelivered on an idle session is done
disposal_reason: Implemented in the w-001e3dde7f84 change after review round 5 (Claude delegation-abc396a8 raised it as a Medium against w-001e). abort_engram_project_reset now drains the affected sessions after its commit (drain_engram_project_reset_sessions). The authority-branch early releases and both persistence-failure rollbacks drop the lock and call release_engram_project_reset_fence, which clears the waiting reason, commits and drains. The test an_aborted_settings_change_drains_what_it_held_and_restores_the_preview asserts that the held wake is admitted.
